body: TermAl install lesson (Opus2, 2026-11-19). Renaming target/release/termal.exe aside and then running cargo build --release in place leaves NO termal.exe for the whole build (a -j1 release build takes many minutes). Every new delegation spawn fails meanwhile, because the child MCP bridge and TERMAL_CLI point at target/release/termal.exe (Sol-a7bb's post-landing evaluators failed with 'os error 2' / 'MCP Connection closed'). Next time: build the exact master tree into a SEPARATE target dir (for example CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/install-target), verify the built exe and its sha256, and only then rename the running termal.exe to the backup name and copy the new exe into target/release/termal.exe. The gap is then seconds. Send install END to the coordinator and to any blocked spawner.
